question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025, effective which financial year onwards are Angel Funds with total investments at cost exceeding ₹100 crore REQUIRED to mandatorily carry out an annual audit of compliance with terms of PPM?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the September 10, 2025 SEBI circular (SEBI/HO/AFD/AFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/128), Angel Funds with total investments at cost exceeding INR 100 crore are required to mandatorily carry out annual audit of compliance with terms of PPM FROM FY 2025-26 ONWARDS. Smaller Angel Funds remain exempt. The Trap: The earlier FY dates are before the circular date. FY 2026-27 is too late — would mean the September 2025 circular skipped a year of compliance. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C will carry the same September 2025 update. Angel-Fund-specific rules often contrast with the broader Cat I framework in nuanced ways — flag this to the exam-writer. Manager's Pro-Tip: If you run an Angel Fund approaching the ₹100 crore investment mark, pre-schedule a PPM-audit dry run in FY 2024-25 — the first real audit in FY 2025-26 will go smoother if you already have sample-based sample reviews in place.
